summary: 53-year-old Kentucky man suffered severe high altitude sickness at a backcountry campsite near the North Inlet Trail on the west side of the park; a member of his hiking group hiked seven miles out to the North Inlet Trailhead for help; seventeen people including rangers and Grand County Search and Rescue brought him a mile down rough terrain to a landing zone, where Lifeguard 1 helicopter flew him to Medical Center of the Rockies.
location: Backcountry campsite near North Inlet Trail, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers; Grand County Search and Rescue; Lifeguard 1 (St. Anthony Hospital)
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Grand County, Colorado, United States)
